title: A Beginner’s Guide To The End

questions.q: What does lesson 1 advise after learning of a terminal illness?
a: Take things slowly and give yourself time
questions.why: Lesson 1 says it's best to take things slow.

questions.q: When should you tell family and friends the news, per lesson 1?
a: Once you've come to terms with it enough
questions.why: The author says to call them when you feel ready.

questions.q: What should you do with your belongings before dying, per lesson 2?
a: Clear out junk and leave meaningful items
Sell everything and donate the money
Keep everything for your family to sort
questions.why: Lesson 2 says to clean up and leave only what you want to pass on.

questions.q: How did the author's grandmother help her family decide who got what?
questions.why: The grandmother put tape on items with the recipient's name.

questions.q: What image does lesson 3 use for grief?
a: A wave that comes and goes
A long road with no end
A storm that must be outlasted
questions.why: Lesson 3 says to let grief wash over you like a wave.
